egress.terms: Direct-link egress is metered and ad-gated on free; Pro removes ads and gives 1 TB with standard transfer speeds.

record.tooling: No rclone backend (AList has a MediaFire driver). No WebDAV. REST API exists but is oriented at upload/share, not bulk sync.
record.chaining: 10-50 GB units with no rclone backend means the shard count for 20 TB is 400+ accounts against an unaudited REST API. Economically absurd.
record.limits_note: per-object: 4 GB/file free. Bonus scheme caps at 50 GB.
record.reliability_note: 100M users, stable, but tuned for sharing rather than storage; free tier is ad-supported.
